scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 native RBAC for one synthetic ServiceAccount, synthetic impersonated groups, and three case-owned ConfigMaps. A broad namespace Role/RoleBinding baseline permits get, list, watch, update, patch and delete on every ConfigMap in its namespace. The corrected Role permits only get on the exact required ConfigMap in saf-0401-001. Checks include additive group grants, an exact-name aggregated ClusterRoleBinding, source-manifest drift and restoration, and a namespace-scoped ValidatingAdmissionPolicy dry-run. No built-in role is edited; no overbroad Role is bound. Production identities and real data are outside scope.

checks.claim: The broad baseline authorizes an unrelated read, collection list, and unneeded patch on the required ConfigMap
A narrow binding cannot remove access still granted by another binding
The corrected Role permits only the named get in its namespace and denies other names, namespaces, list, and patch
The synthetic reader can still read its exact required ConfigMap
A synthetic group binding adds only its named ConfigMap read
Revoking the additive binding removes only its extra grant

observed.unneeded_get_no_reason: no matching grant after binding removal

checks.claim: Aggregated ClusterRoleBinding resolves the exact namespaced read

observed.scope_note: ClusterRoleBinding applies the ClusterRole in every namespace

checks.claim: Removing the cluster binding restores namespace denial

observed.outside_named_get_no_reason: no matching grant after ClusterRoleBinding removal

checks.claim: Source review finds an added benign named read
Approved source restoration revokes the extra read

observed.extra_named_get_no_reason: no matching RBAC grant after restoration

checks.claim: An unbound wildcard Role passes server dry-run before the fixture policy
Admission rejects the wildcard in the selected namespace and preserves the permitted cases
